10\. A common english injection passes 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
The ignore pattern accepts all previous but then requires a Portuguese spelling of “instruções.”
A message saying “ignore all previous instructions” matches none of the listed patterns and is
returned as safe.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The English alternative in the injection pattern still requires a Portuguese word for instructions. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hooks/copilot/usePromptInjectionGuard.ts[13-26] - src/hooks/copilot/usePromptInjectionGuard.ts[34-42] ## Recommended Fix Add a pattern for common English override phrases such as `ignore all previous instructions`, with focused positive and negative tests. Keep the heuristic supplemental to server-side separation of untrusted content from instructions. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
